relationships.subject: donepezil
relationships.evidence_quote: The protein expression levels of NLRP3, STAT3, ser727 and HIF-1α were lower in the samples treated with donepezil and memantine at 72 h (p < 0.05).

relationships.subject: memantine
relationships.evidence_quote: The protein expression levels of NLRP3, STAT3, ser727 and HIF-1α were lower in the samples treated with donepezil and memantine at 72 h (p < 0.05).

key_findings: Donepezil and memantine individually lowered NLRP3, STAT3, HIF-1α in degenerated disc cells at 72 h; the combination increased them.
